method: Reviewed current source file and exact UID per record; compared current student/item fingerprints to saved pre-edit baseline; checked canonical course/unit/subunit and active PT/TPL binding parent, exact source binding owner, native taxonomy L1-L4, locked RPM crosswalk disposition without aliasing native values, positive/negative criteria, CrossConcept and Condition key/status/reason, integration pattern, and independently recorded level/bucket/confidence/reason. Historical R1/R2 were support-only, never current Meta witnesses. Protected fields were compared against HEAD and unchanged.
